terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Araqs (araqs.com) is a classifieds board for buying and selling beautiful phone numbers from Armenian carriers. By using the site you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: What Araqs is
sections.body: Araqs is a classifieds board, not a marketplace or a telecom operator. We don't buy or sell numbers ourselves, don't handle payment, and don't guarantee either side of a deal. All agreements about price, payment, and number transfer are made directly between the seller and the buyer, outside the platform.

sections.title: Who can post a listing
sections.body: Anyone who has verified ownership of their phone number by SMS code can list a number for sale. You may only sell numbers you actually own, served by an Armenian carrier (Viva, Ucom, or Team Telecom).

sections.title: Listing accuracy
sections.body: The seller is responsible for the accuracy of the listing — price, tier, operator, region, and description. The operator and number type the site detects automatically from the number's prefix are a hint, not a guarantee: because of number portability (MNP) the actual operator can differ, and the seller must review and correct these fields before publishing if needed.

sections.title: Payment and number transfer
sections.body: Araqs is not involved in payment, number transfer, or any other step of the deal between seller and buyer — all of that happens outside the platform. We recommend caution, and not sending money before meeting in person or otherwise verifying the other party.

sections.title: What listing costs
sections.body: Basic listing is free — for every tier, premium included, with no time limit. We take no commission on the deal and take no part in payments between the seller and the buyer. Only promotion of a listing on the marketplace and advertising may be paid for; the current terms are always shown on this page.

sections.title: Prohibited content
sections.body: You may not list numbers you don't own, post knowingly false information, abusive, fraudulent, or spam content, or anything that violates the laws of Armenia. Such listings are removed without notice, and access may be restricted.

sections.title: Moderation and reports
sections.body: We may decline or remove any listing that raises concerns, without explanation. Any visitor can report a listing using the "Report" button — reports are reviewed manually.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: The site is provided "as is". Araqs does not guarantee uninterrupted service or the accuracy of listings posted by other users, and is not liable for losses arising from deals between users.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always available on this page; the last-updated date is shown at the top.

sections.title: Paying for the marketplace's services
sections.body: Posting listings is free. Only promotion services, monthly subscriptions and the fee for a seller's second and further listings are paid — they are listed with their prices under «Rules → Promotion». All prices are in Armenian drams (AMD) and include all applicable taxes. Payment is made by bank card on the acquiring bank's secure page; the card number is never passed to the Araqs site and is not stored by us.

sections.title: When a service counts as delivered
sections.body: A promotion is switched on once the payment arrives and runs for 30 calendar days from that moment. A monthly subscription runs for 30 calendar days from the moment it is switched on. The fee for a second and further listings relates to that specific listing and counts as delivered once it is published.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: If a service was paid for but never switched on, the money is refunded in full. If the service is running, the refund covers the unused whole days of its term. To request a refund, write to support quoting the payment date and the listing; we reply within three business days. Refunds go back to the same card the payment came from; how quickly it lands depends on the cardholder's bank.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Araqs collects when you use the site, why, and who it's shared with.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: The phone number you provide for sign-in and SMS verification; listing details you enter yourself (the number for sale, operator, type, region, price, description); technical data about your visit (IP address, browser language) and a cookie that remembers your chosen language.

sections.title: SMS verification
sections.body: To verify phone ownership we use Twilio Verify: the number you enter is sent to Twilio solely to deliver a one-time code, and isn't used by Araqs for anything else besides sign-in and (when it matches the listed number) the "SMS verified" badge.

sections.title: Where data is stored
sections.body: Araqs' database is hosted by Supabase in the EU (Frankfurt). The site itself runs on Vercel's infrastructure. Both are independent technical providers processing data on Araqs' behalf.

sections.title: Who can see your data
sections.body: A seller's phone number becomes visible to a buyer only after the buyer taps "Contact" on the listing page. We don't sell or share your personal data with third parties for advertising or other commercial purposes.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The site uses one functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your chosen interface language. There are currently no advertising or analytics cookies on the site.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to delete your listing or account by contacting us below — we'll remove the relevant data, except where the law requires us to keep it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For questions about how we handle personal data, contact us at support@araqs.com.

transfer.title: Transferring a number
transfer.warning: Attention! A phone number must be transferred at an official operator office, with both the current and the new subscriber present and holding their passports. The operator may charge a fee, and its size can depend on the number's category.
transfer.howSteps: Both subscribers come to the operator's office in person, with passports. The current owner files a request, the new one signs a contract in their own name. The number changes hands the same day.
transfer.vivaRule: A flat {fixed} ֏ for the procedure itself plus the full category price. If the number has been owned for more than 24 months by an individual, or 6 months by a company, the category part is waived — only the {fixed} ֏ remain.
transfer.teamRule: The full category price plus {fixed} ֏. No reductions for length of ownership: however long the number has been yours, the category part stays.
transfer.teamContract: Transferring numbers of the «Silver» category and above requires signing a contract with the Be Free postpaid tariff package.
transfer.ucomRule: For the «Gold», «Platinum» and «Diamond» categories half the category price is charged. For «Silver» and «Bronze» — a flat {flat} ֏.
transfer.ucomNoObligation: The stated tariffs apply without obligation.
transfer.notPublishedTitle: Categories this operator does not have
transfer.notPublished: This operator publishes no separate categories above «Diamond». Our estimate for the «Elite» and «Premium» statuses is calculated from the top published category — the exact amount is quoted by the operator in their office.
transfer.ourScaleNote: Our status scale follows Viva's, so Viva's names match ours, while Team Telecom and Ucom have categories of their own.
transfer.sourceNote: The figures were taken from the operators' pages on 09.09.2026. Rules and tariffs are set by the operator and may change — the most current ones are always on their site, at the links above.
transfer.otherOperatorsNote: The marketplace also carries numbers from other telecoms operators, landlines included. Their transfer rules are their own — check their websites or offices.

common.empty: There are no such numbers on the marketplace right now. Have a look at the full catalogue — there are others there — or get your own number valued.

viva.title: Beautiful Viva numbers
viva.intro: Viva numbers on the 77, 93, 94, 98 and 49 codes. These are the ones sellers have listed on Araqs: with repeats, mirrored stretches, round endings and the other patterns that make a number beautiful.
body: The status scale on the marketplace follows Viva's own, from Bronze to Premium. So for Viva numbers the status name on the site matches what the operator calls the category in their office.

Viva's transfer terms are the gentlest of the three: a flat 500 ֏ for the procedure plus the category price, and the category part is waived if the number has been owned for more than 24 months by an individual or 6 months by a company.

ucom.title: Beautiful Ucom numbers
ucom.intro: Ucom numbers on the mobile codes 55, 95, 41 and 44, plus landlines on 11 and 12. Every beautiful number of this operator listed on Araqs, with its pattern valued and the transfer fee already worked out.
body: Ucom has its own scale of five categories: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. The operator publishes nothing above Diamond, so for the rarest numbers the exact amount is quoted in their office.

Ucom calculates the transfer fee differently from the others: half the category price for Gold, Platinum and Diamond, and a flat 1,000 ֏ for Silver and Bronze. The stated tariffs apply without obligation.

team.title: Beautiful Team Telecom numbers
team.intro: Team Telecom numbers on the codes 91, 96, 99, 43 and 33, plus landlines on 10. In Armenia this operator was long known as Beeline, and earlier still as ArmenTel — if you are looking for «Beeline numbers», this is the place.
body: Team has six categories, and one of them exists nowhere else: Nickel, the most affordable at 2,000 ֏. Above it come Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond.

Transfers cost more at Team than at its neighbours: the full category price plus 700 ֏, with no reduction for length of ownership. Transferring a Silver number or above requires a contract with the Be Free postpaid package.

gold.title: Gold numbers of Armenia
gold.intro: «Gold» is what the market calls numbers with a clear but not rarest pattern: three identical digits, a repeating pair, a round ending. Our engine gives Gold status to numbers with a beauty index between 45 and 54.
body: Gold sits in the middle of the scale and is its most traded part. Such a number already sticks in the ear and is easy to dictate over the phone, yet costs several times less than a premium one. At the operators the Gold category costs around 60,000–65,000 ֏.

The beauty index is calculated by the engine, not claimed by the seller: it breaks the number down digit by digit, finds the pattern and assigns the status. So Gold on Araqs means the same thing on every listing.

vip.title: VIP numbers of Armenia — premium, elite, diamond
vip.intro: The rarest part of the catalogue: the Premium, Elite and Diamond statuses, with a beauty index from 72 to 100. These are numbers you remember the first time you hear them — like 55 90 90 90, or mirrored stretches of six digits.
body: The market calls them different things: VIP, exclusive, «a bomb». It amounts to the same: the pattern is visible at once and there is nothing to match it — the operator has only a handful of such combinations.

Prices start in the hundreds of thousands of drams and run past a million. The operator's transfer fee is added to the seller's price, and Viva, Ucom and Team each calculate it differently — the listing card shows the full amount already.

mirror.title: Mirrored numbers
mirror.intro: A mirrored number reads the same left to right and right to left — 41 14 00 41, say, or the stretch 14 00 41. Such a number is almost impossible to write down wrong, and that is exactly why it is prized.
body: The engine looks for mirrored stretches of four to six digits. The longer the mirror, the higher the beauty index and the status: a six-digit mirror usually reaches Elite or above.
Mirrored numbers are markedly rarer than repeats — an operator has few combinations of this shape. If none are listed right now, look again in a week, or have your own number valued.

triple.title: Numbers with three identical digits
triple.h1: Three identical digits in a row
triple.intro: The most recognisable pattern of all: three, four or more identical digits in a row — 55 90 90 90, 77 24 44 44. A number like this is dictated over the phone first time and sticks in the ear.
body: Three identical digits is where this pattern's scale begins. Four in a row already costs markedly more; five and above turn up in single figures and land in Premium.
What matters is that the digits run consecutively: 44 84 14 14 is not a triple but a repeated pair, and it is valued on a different scale. The engine tells these cases apart itself.

round.title: Round numbers ending in zeros
round.intro: A round number ends in zeros: 77 24 10 00, 55 90 20 000. The more zeros in the tail, the rounder the number and the higher its status.
body: Two trailing zeros make for a noticeable but affordable number. Three is already a rarity; four or more turn up in single figures.
Companies are especially fond of round numbers: easy to print on a sign and to read out to a customer. If you are choosing a number for a business, start here.

glossary.title: A glossary of beautiful numbers
glossary.h1: Glossary: what beautiful numbers are called
glossary.intro: The market calls the same thing by different names — in Armenian, in Russian and in Latin letters, all mixed together. Here is what stands behind each word.
glossary.spellingTitle: Why one word gets spelled three ways
glossary.spellingBody: Armenian words are often typed in Latin letters — it is quicker on a phone and more usual in messages. So «գեղեցիկ համար» also appears as «gexecik hamar» and «geghetsik hamar». It is the same word, and people mean the same thing by it.

terms.also: gexecik hamar · geghetsik hamar · beautiful number
terms.means: The general name for any number with a pattern. The broadest word of all: both «gold» and «VIP» fall under it.
A number with a clear pattern of middling rarity: three identical digits, a repeated pair, a round ending. Here that is the Gold status, beauty index 45–54.
The rarest numbers. Here that means Premium, Elite and Diamond — index 72 to 100. The word is imprecise: different sellers use it for different things.
Colloquial. A number you remember instantly: 55 90 90 90 and the like. In meaning, the same as VIP.
«Exclusive». Used for a number the operator has only a handful of. Usually the top of the scale.
The status between Gold and Diamond, index 60–69. At the operators this is a separate category with its own price.
The top category at Team and Ucom. Here it corresponds to the Diamond status, index 72–79.
Changing the owner of a number at the operator's office. The operator charges a fee for it, and Viva, Ucom and Team each calculate it differently.

glossary.afterTitle: How our status differs from the operator's category
glossary.afterBody: An operator names a category when it sells a new number, and each has its own scale. Our status is calculated by the engine from the number itself, identically for every listing: it breaks the digits down, finds the pattern and assigns a status with an index from 0 to 100.
